protocol.configuration_policy_sampling: Independent uniform pre-outcome draws, no outcome filtering/resampling
protocol.burn_in: Exact actual episode prefix, length varies; gradients stopped before last four transitions
protocol.window_sampling: Episode-count-weighted length group; 50% endpoint, 50% uniform shared end index
protocol.selection: No architecture/objective/hyperparameter selection; all predeclared conditions retained
protocol.final_rule: Freeze hashes after development evaluation; collect final episodes only afterward; no final-set tuning
protocol.comparability: Same optimizer steps and loss-target count, variable burn-in CPU cost; varied-small is a size control with only 16 episodes, not identical coverage
